Yes, We will follow up with you 7 days prior to your check-in date to complete the check-in process and arrange the outstanding balance payment.

Please note that our standard check-in time starts at 3:00 PM. However, if the apartment is ready earlier, we will be more than happy to provide early access, subject to availability.

Once the unit is ready for check-in, our team will share the check-in details with you here, allowing you to proceed with the self-check-in process.
